Use case: ui-mockup. Create one realistic, polished, production-quality mobile app HOME SCREEN concept for iPhone 17. App-content-only portrait frame, logical target 390 x 844 points, crisp high-resolution output preserving that aspect ratio. No external phone body, bezel, notch, system status bar, presentation board or collage. This is one independent design, not six screens. Intended audience: Danish men 18–35 who feel snus/nicotine pouches dominate their lives and want freedom, more everyday energy and saved money. Danish UI only. Working app name "FRI". Primary home screen hierarchy must prominently show "375 kr." with label "Anslået sparet", show "15 dage uden snus", and a large clearly tappable primary action "Jeg har lyst lige nu". Small secondary action "Jeg tog en pose". Bottom navigation may have three understated destinations "I dag", "Min plan", "Fremskridt". Optionally small supportive copy "Mere plads til dig." No health promises or energy percentages. No invented charts, no scientific claims, no paywall. Keep only hero progress and immediate help, no feature inventory. Use generous whitespace, clear hierarchy, legible typography, touch targets, coherent professional UI. No nested cards, no grid of dashboard cards. Keep Danish text accurate, all important content fully in frame. No visible direction labels, option numbers, explanation, or watermark. Current date is 21 September 2026, but avoid showing calendar dates. The supplied reference is conceptual background only: warmth and approachable quitting support. Do not copy its smoking graphics, palette, UI, phone frame, social post, revenue claims or text. This is a fresh stylistic exploration with the direction below.
Art direction: POCKET INSTRUMENT. Inventive premium handheld electronic instrument, tactile teenage-engineering nostalgia matured into refined industrial design. Charcoal almost-black base, acid yellow markings, pale sage LCD-like savings display, subtle brushed graphite material. The savings are the hero of a single broad inset instrument window with enormous tasteful monospaced "375 kr." numerals and "Anslået sparet". Below, 15 small precise illuminated segments accompanied by "15 dage uden snus"; clear symbolic progress only, no fabricated health metric. Bold physical-feeling acid yellow primary button "Jeg har lyst lige nu", soft mechanical pressed depth, restrained industrial labels. Some beautiful intentional hardware detailing, carefully readable contemporary UI. It should feel like a new cult design object made by an experimental Scandinavian audio company, not a spaceship, generic fintech dashboard or gamer HUD. Simple clear mobile interface with generous breathing room and disciplined alignment.

Art direction: OPEN HORIZON. Meditative yet masculine outdoor editorial interface with a stunning cinematic photographic Danish coastline, dune grass in the foreground and vast blue-grey sky at early morning. Photo is immersive full bleed, muted cold blue and silver, a small warm sunrise glow. Airy gorgeous white typography across the quiet sky area, extremely readable with subtle controlled atmospheric darkening behind type. Main hero quit duration "15 dage uden snus" in dramatic large airy type in the upper third, with "375 kr." and "Anslået sparet" clearly present as a strong secondary typographic composition mid-screen. Vast horizon expresses freedom and making room in life. Lower primary action in a simple solid cream pill with dark ink text, no frosted glass card stack. Understated floating bottom navigation, still legible. Mood premium nature journal, the feeling of leaving a crowded room for fresh air, no fitness bro or generic mountain stock photo. Danish coastal setting, gorgeous art direction, quiet spacious focused functional screen.

Art direction: SOFT REBELLION. Unconventional modern Danish streetwear poster transformed into a highly usable home screen. Vivid tomato-red base, light pink oversized extreme condensed typography and sharp dark plum UI anchors. Big stacked typographic statement "MERE\nPLADS\nTIL DIG." in the top third, closely composed but perfectly legible. Oversized simple lavender sculptural inflated ribbon twists once like a freed knot alongside typography, integrated thoughtfully, avoiding cigarette or pouch associations. Below this bold editorial hero, absolutely clear large "375 kr." with "Anslået sparet" and strong "15 dage uden snus" on one flat pink-tinted progress region with no border or shadow. Giant dark plum primary CTA with warm white text "Jeg har lyst lige nu". Bare secondary text action, minimalist bottom nav. Precise Swiss alignment underneath expressive editorial design. Confident, energetic, hopeful, youthful adult fashion art direction with real product clarity. No childish stickers, no dashboard grids, no generic rounded-card wellness app, no illustration overload.
